## Course Website

[Canvas](https://canvas.instructure.com/courses/1649198) is the primary source for:

* Announcements
* Lecture slides
* Homework
* Grades
* Course Q/A


If you haven't done so already, please:

* Make a Canvas account and enroll in the course through
https://canvas.instructure.com/register. Use the code **CN9JHC**
* Change your \href{https://canvas.instructure.com/profile/communication}{notification settings} for announcements to ``Notify me right away'' 
* Post a message in the chat window if you need help!
